name: Oliver
source: Oliver serves in a small police department in the quiet town of Lind, where little ever happens. Responsible and diligent, he balances his routine patrols with life at home. But when a series of unsettling events begins to unfold, Oliver finds himself stumbling into scenes of blood, fear, and disappearances. With no answers and rising unease, he continues to investigate, unaware he's being pulled into a darkness the town has never seen before.
